120280101.text: We haven't been to the Yae Publishing House in a while. Paimon wonders if they have any new books in? The one we read with Ei that time was pretty cool...

120280102.text: Come on, this is a no-brainer, man! There's only one thing worth wishing for — and that is a ton of Mora!

120280103.text: But the exam's next week... If I fail again, I'm seriously done for. I'm better off wishing that my exam goes smoothly.

120280104.text: Ahh, it's just an exam! Trust me, there's no problem you can't solve by throwing Mora at it. If it doesn't work, then just keep throwing till it does!

120280105.text: What are they arguing about? It's quite a spirited debate.

120280106.text: Huh...? Really? You guys don't know?

120280107.text: "You need but stand on this land at midnight, lower your head and recite a special incantation, then your wish will come true!"

120280110.text: Looks like you guys really aren't in the loop. This, my friends, is the next big thing. A highly effective wish ritual, guaranteed to make your wishes come true!

120280113.text: Right? Even Paimon knows that's just not how the world works.

120280114.text: Heh, I didn't believe it at first, either. But that changed when it worked for someone I know.

120280115.text: It's this guy called Kunihiko. He's practically always been unemployed, wastes his days away, and he owes a lot of money... like, a lot! But get this — I don't see him for a few days, and suddenly I find him dressed to the nines and feasting at a high-class restaurant!

120280116.text: I heard it directly from him. He used this wishing ritual, and the next day he woke up to find his whole bed filled high with Mora!

120280117.text: His whole bed was filled with M—M—M...!? Woooow!!!

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate a kaidan that has been making the rounds recently

120280201.text: On closer inspection, it seems like there really are a lot of people talking about this kind of stuff. Hey, see those two? Paimon remembers them from the Yae Publishing House. One's an editor and the other's an author.

120280202.text: ...Grasp the thought in mind, clear like... ah, clear like the light of the moon. As close as kin with you... no, "thou"... wait, "thee." Uh, hear my... summons, right?

120280203.text: No, no, it's not "hear my summons," it's "heed my summons," "heed." *sigh* You're never going to get it down at this rate.

120280204.text: Hey, what are you guys up to?

120280205.text: Whoa! Sheesh, you scared me. Okay, okay... Where did I leave off with the incantation, again...

120280206.text: Incantation? Are you guys trying out this new wishing ritual stuff, too?

120280207.text: Junkichi is trying it out, to be specific. He's hit a bit of a creativity block recently, so I'm helping him make a wish so that he can move past it.

120280208.text: I didn't think you guys would believe in this kind of thing.

120280209.text: I mean, I obviously don't. But Junkichi never listens to an outside opinion. So all I can do is go along with it.

120280210.text: Mr. Shigeru, can you please be a little more accommodating? This is extremely important to me!

120280211.text: People have had all kinds of wishes come true: become more attractive, get rich quick, ace their studies... I'm just a poor, struggling writer looking to get over a creative hurdle. Is that so much to ask?

120280212.text: Anyway, I just know this is going to work. I have a gut feeling about it.

120280213.text: Didn't you say the same thing when you went to make your wish at the Grand Narukami Shrine? "Oh, I just know this is gonna work, I have a gut feeling about it."

120280214.text: The omamori from the shrine take too long to have any effect on your luck. Ugh, alright, enough of that, help me get this incantation down. My new book depends on it!

120280215.text: *sigh* Look, to be completely honest, I think you need to sit down and have a good think about what kind of story you wanna write. Where's all that self-confidence you had when you first started out?

120280216.text: Look at you now! Trying dubious methods from any old light novel.

120280217.text: Wait, wait, wait... What? This wishing ritual comes from a light novel?

120280218.text: Yup. It's from the one called "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits."

120280219.text: Is it published by Yae Publishing House?

120280220.text: No, it's most likely a self-published title. It just appeared out of nowhere and took Inazuma by storm.

120280221.text: As a fellow writer, I'll refrain from passing comment on how well the story is written. But everyone is saying the wishing incantations it contains are the real deal.

120280222.text: Look, Junkichi... yes, everyone's saying it's real, it works, but that's only half the story. I've also heard lots of people saying that everyone who's had their wish granted using this method starts behaving strangely!

120280223.text: What's so surprising about that? They're probably just giddy with joy at having their wish come true!

120280224.text: Hmm, this is starting to sound a little suspicious...

120280225.text: #Why don't we go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and ask Yae Miko about it, {NICKNAME}?

120280226.text: She's the expert when it comes to both light novels and the supernatural!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and look for Yae Miko

120280302.text: Well hello there, young ones. What brings you to the shrine? It just so happens that I have a wonderful novel here. I highly recommend it.

120280303.text: We'd like your expert input on something.

120280304.text: Oh? Well what did you want to ask?

120280305.text: Well, we were just... Uh, actually, you look kinda busy, is this a bad time?

120280306.text: Hehe, no, not at all. It's nothing major.

120280307.text: L—Lady Guuji... what do you mean, "nothing major"? I'm begging you, you've gotta help me save my brother!

120280310.text: It really is nothing major, I stand by that. Oh, but since you're so curious, let's have him relate the story one more time, just for you.

120280311.text: You two seem to have a good relationship with Guuji Yae. Please, put in a good word for me, you have to convince her to help my brother!

120280312.text: Here's what happened. My name is Katou Youhei, and my brother is Katou Shingo. All he's ever wanted is to become a swordmaster, so he once asked Sensei Domon of the Meikyou Shisui Art to take him on as a disciple.

120280313.text: Domon turned him away. Took one look at him and said he didn't have what it takes to train in the art of the sword. But my brother wasn't about to resign himself to defeat — he trained every day as hard as he could, and finally proved himself by defeating one of Domon's best disciples in a duel recently.

120280314.text: But since his victory, he's been acting extremely strange. It's like he's become a completely different person... The doctors can't find anything wrong with him, so I'm betting it must be the work of an evil spirit. That's why I'm here begging for Guuji Yae's help...

120280315.text: Hahaha... You know, there really aren't as many evil spirits lurking around as you seem to think. Your brother achieved the goal he'd been striving toward for as long as he can remember, and now it's gone. It's only natural that he feels a little empty and lost while he's trying to find a new direction.

120280316.text: If it were me, I'd just leave him be for a couple of days. He'll recover on his own soon enough.

120280317.text: No, Lady Guuji! If you saw him for yourself, you'd know. I guarantee you, he is not acting like someone who feels empty and lost!

120280318.text: Oh, alright, alright. Then tell me, when did your brother spar with Domon's disciple?

120280320.text: Hmm... five days ago, you say...

120280321.text: Yes, Lady Guuji. That's a long time for him to be acting up like this. I'm really worried about him!

120280322.text: Our greatest wish is to one day found our own school, just like Domon. We can't jeopardize that dream now!

120280323.text: Wait a minute, now I'm a little confused. Are you here to save your brother, or are you here to make your dreams of founding a martial arts school come true?

120280324.text: Uh... Well they're kinda two sides of the same coin, aren't they?

120280325.text: Hmm? Whatever. Let me ask you this, have you heard of any interesting new rumors lately? If so, I'd love to hear about them.

120280326.text: Wh—What? Rumors? I... I haven't heard anything!

120280327.text: Oh dear. Well, that's too bad.

120280328.text: Lady Guuji, please, stop changing the subject. This is someone's life we're talking about here! Please, you've gotta help me!

120280329.text: Miko, he seems really desperate. This thing with his brother sounds really bad... Come on, you should help him.

120280701.text: Hmm, how strange. My brother's been meditating here pretty much constantly over the past few days, but now he's gone!

120280703.text: Yeah, it's something that he suddenly started doing after defeating Domon's disciple. He just sits there alone, talking to himself... It's pretty disturbing, actually.

120280704.text: But that's not important right now! Where the heck could he have gone in his current state?

120280705.text: Hmm, this does pose a bit of a problem. If we can't find your brother, well, we can't perform an exorcism with nothing to exorcise, can we?

120280706.text: Katou whatever-your-name-was, given the circumstances, why don't you start by going to find your brother and also picking up a handful of salt on your way. We'll need to use it during the exorcism.

120280707.text: Okay... okay, got it! I'm on it!

120280708.text: Miko, what about us? Shouldn't we help look for his brother, too?

120280709.text: Hehe, no need. While what's-his-face is handling that, we'll take a walk around and ask people what they know about the two brothers. Maybe we'll find out some amusing details.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask the villagers about Youhei and his brother

120280801.text: Hello, Sir! We'd like to ask you about the Katou brothers.

120280802.text: Oh, are you debt collectors? Youhei said to tell you not to worry — he'll be able to pay you back as soon as he has enrolled a few disciples...

120280803.text: Huh? Debt collectors? No, no, we're not here for anything like that!

120280804.text: But, uh, it sounds like Youhei and Shingo have gotten themselves into a bit of a pickle...

120280805.text: Well, yes, I don't think there's any disputing that. Those two don't have an ounce of dedication between them. They just hop between ideas and won't stick to anything.

120280806.text: Huh? But Youhei said his brother has always wanted to become a swordmaster, and even asked Domon to be his sensei.

120280807.text: That's true, yes. Shingo begged Domon to take him on and eventually, he finally relented. But even after convincing a renowned sensei to give him a chance, he was the same as ever, bumming around in class instead of focusing on his training.

120280808.text: In the end, Domon had enough and kicked him out. But Shingo was resentful about it. He blamed Domon for not seeing his potential, and even declared that he would challenge a disciple of Domon to a duel.

120280809.text: Wait, what? That's not what we heard...

120280810.text: Oh, how interesting. We heard a slightly different version: "My brother wasn't about to resign himself to defeat — he trained every day as hard as he could, and finally proved himself by defeating one of Domon's best disciples in a duel recently."

120280811.text: Haha! Youhei said that? That Shingo trained hard? That's ridiculous, he just lay there cussing to high heaven all day, every day. Some training regimen that is.

120280812.text: Youhei did tell me about Shingo winning the fight, but I took it with a grain of salt. You can ask Kenji at the village entrance more about that. He always has reliable information.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask the villagers for more information

120280401.text: Hey there, we've come to ask you about the Katou brothers!

120280402.text: Oh, you mean Shingo and Youhei?

120280403.text: Yeah! We heard that Shingo defeated an apprentice of Domon's recently. Is that true?

120280404.text: Haha, yes it's true. Wait, so are you here because you heard they're starting their own school and you're looking to sign up?

120280405.text: We're not here to sign up, but we would like to hear more details about the fight.

120280406.text: Well, you've come to the right person. I actually went to watch it.

120280407.text: I thought it was a joke when I first heard that Shingo was going to challenge a disciple of the Meikyou Shisui Art. But when he drew his sword, whoa. He became a whole different person.

120280408.text: The way he handled his blade, it was like flowing water. Mesmerizing to watch. Domon's disciple is no pushover, but he was absolutely no match for Shingo.

120280410.text: Yup. He seemed pretty euphoric after winning the duel, too... he was celebrating very vocally, saying something like "What a duel! I haven't felt this good in a long time!"

120280411.text: Hehe, any other details to share? We've heard that Shingo has been behaving rather out of character since then.

120280412.text: Hmm... I'd definitely say that he has more energy than he used to. In the past, he never used to do much except lie around sunbathing all day.

120280413.text: But just yesterday, for example, I saw him cutting down trees for the village head. In the space of one afternoon, he did what most people couldn't finish in three days. Not only that, but he managed to fell a Lavender Melon Tree with just one kick!

120280417.text: Things got weird after that though. The village head brought out some tofu for him, and he just flipped out. He shouted: "What is that stuff!? Keep that away from me!" then ran off.

120280418.text: Lady Guuji. Esteemed exorcists. Finally, I've found you!

120280419.text: I found my brother, he's at the waterfall. And I've got the salt you asked for, too. C'mon, let's go!

120280420.text: As much as I'd prefer to stay and hear some more delicious details, I suppose we had better be going now that he's been found.

120280501.text: So this is Youhei's brother. Whoa, he's meditating while sitting in a waterfall! That's pretty wild!

120280502.text: Hey, listen, he's talking to himself...

120280504.text: Whoo... Hehehe... How's that! Can you... feel it!?

120280506.text: Can you feel... the feeling... of manliness!

120280507.text: Found your own school... Hah! So shallow... How can a manly man... aspire to something... so... lame!?

120280508.text: ...Ugh... Please, spare me... spare me... I—I can't feel the... m—manliness... I can't even feel the cold anymore...

120280509.text: ...I... I can't take any more... I'm gonna die...

120280510.text: Youhei... Youhei! S—Save me! Save me!!!

120280511.text: #Did you hear that, {NICKNAME}? All the nonsense aside, he's calling for help!

120280513.text: He stood up... and now he's coming this way!

120280516.text: #What do we do? {NICKNAME}, Miko! Think of something!

120280518.text: Youhei, your brother's life is hanging in the balance, and he's using his final breaths to call on you for help. Whatever shall we do?

120280519.text: Uh, I... Well, how should I know?

120280520.text: The way it looks to me is that Shingo feels terribly resentful to you about something. Would you mind telling me what that's all about?

120280521.text: I don't know what to tell you! I don't know!

120280522.text: You don't know? But surely you should have more insight than anyone else into how your brother came to be this way?

120280523.text: Youhei, I suggest you think very carefully before you open your mouth again. This is a life-or-death situation.

120280525.text: "Uhhh! Umm... Ummm..."? Your brother is your closest relative. You must have noticed straight away when he started acting out of character.

120280526.text: And yet five whole days pass before it occurs to you to come and seek help from me. You really expect me not to notice the gaping holes in your story?

120280528.text: As you wish. It's fine by me if you don't want to tell the truth.

120280529.text: But after Shingo dies, you'll be next.

120280530.text: It's futile trying to escape. Anywhere in the world you run to, it will be right behind your back. After all... you did summon it together.

120280532.text: Alright, I'll talk, I'll talk! I'll tell you everything! ...My brother and I used a wishing incantation. We made a wish!

120280535.text: Yes! Yes, that's it! The one that's all the rage right now. You just have to recite an incantation at midnight and your wish will be granted!

120280536.text: Just like the book described, we drew the magic symbol, stepped inside it barefoot at midnight, said the incantation, and lo and behold — spheres of light appeared all around us!

120280537.text: After my brother wished to become a swordmaster, it really worked — out of nowhere, he suddenly had these amazing sword skills. But his whole personality changed, too!

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the spirit that has possessed Shingo
Investigate the truth behind the spirit

120280601.text: Hehe... Hahaha... That was great, excellent! Wooh! What a rush!

120280602.text: I haven't felt this great... in a long, long time!

120280603.text: He... disappeared. But he looked pretty content at the end there.

120280604.text: #Huh, well, Paimon sure is confused. Do you know what that was all about, {NICKNAME}?

120280607.text: Ah, we can talk about it later. They're about to wake up.

120280608.text: *cough cough* ...What am I doing here... Youhei? Youhei, is that you?

120280610.text: Youhei, I had the weirdest dream...

120280611.text: I dreamed that I wasn't a useless loser with the sword anymore. I even beat one of Domon's disciples.

120280612.text: I thought we could finally open a dojo of our own now... but then I realized, I couldn't control my own body, and there was this voice in my ear talking to me constantly.

120280613.text: I was terrified and I wanted to take control of my body back, but I couldn't. And the voice kept talking about "manliness"...

120280614.text: Shingo, we shouldn't have made that wish. We summoned a spirit and... it possessed you!

120280615.text: Yes, and had we not come to your rescue, your life would've been over before too much longer. Then, the spirit would have haunted your brother until he died of fatigue, too.

120280616.text: Thank you, Lady Guuji! And thank you for your assistance, exorcism experts!

120280617.text: Alright, take him to get some rest. He's very weak right now, having been possessed for quite a few days.

120280618.text: He will experience a high fever, but it won't be fatal. Remember, this is the price you pay.

120280619.text: At this point, I would normally lecture you on the dire consequences of using occult methods to obtain power that does not belong to you... but I think you get the picture now, don't you?

120280620.text: Yes... we understand now! We won't ever do it again!

120280621.text: Thank you, Lady Guuji! Thank you, exorcists!

120280622.text: We'll be on our way then. Come on, Shingo.

120280623.text: Miko, would they really have lost their lives if we hadn't gotten involved?

120280624.text: And if so... why the heck were you so reluctant to help out!?

120280626.text: I had to scare them a little, though. Otherwise I hardly think these two lazy rascals would have learned their lesson.

120280627.text: So... what was it that possessed Shingo?

120280628.text: You saw it all for yourselves. I'm sure you can figure out what kind of spirit had possessed him, can't you?

120280901.text: Come on, bring me Mora... Mora, Mora, and more Mora...

120280902.text: I'm not as greedy as he is... I just wanna get through my exam...

120281001.text: Grasp the thought in mind, clear like the light of the moon... how does it go after that?

120281002.text: Junkichi, just give it up. Do you really think someone's going to just descend from the heavens and write your novel for you? I can't believe I'm saying this to a writer, but you need to learn to separate fact from fiction.

120281003.text: Mr. Shigeru, please! I'd appreciate it if you stopped trying to tear my dreams to smithereens. I am in great distress and desperately need to make a breakthrough!

120281101.text: I always used to tell Shingo to stop wasting his time, find something worthwhile to do, and stick to it.

120281102.text: Their parents passed away when they were young, and as the older of the two, he should be setting a good example rather than lazing around all the time... Of course, he wouldn't listen to me.

120281103.text: In my opinion, he hasn't had things bad enough yet to really feel the heat. He doesn't understand that you have to stay grounded and focused in life.

120281201.text: Shingo's been pretty upbeat lately, but for some reason, Youhei's been in a really gloomy mood. I thought they were about to start taking on disciples and start their new chapter — what could be getting him down?

120281202.text: Maybe it's the weight of the responsibility dawning on him? If so, I guess Youhei's finally growing up.
